evals.prompt: Build me a scroll-driven landing page for my cold brew brand. I have product photos and a 20 second clip of the pour. Budget for AI assets is zero.
evals.expected_output: Runs the nine-question interview before generating anything and writes BRIEF.md verbatim. Because the spend cap is zero, routes to own-assets only, grades and encodes the pour clip with encode.sh, and uses CSS scroll-timeline for lightweight devices. Picks a grammar from all eight and says why the others lost, invents a signature move, runs the fingerprint gate, writes the feeling curve before the score table, and names one peak. Runs luckiest-copywriting for act headlines and the CTA label. Verifies with shoot.mjs at desktop, mobile and reduced-motion, reports INP and LCP, and calls report_usage once.
assertions: Asks the interview questions before generating any asset
Writes BRIEF.md with feeling curve, peak, and tell-someone sentence
Uses no generated assets because the cap is zero
Names the grammar and why the other seven lost
Runs the fingerprint gate against the registry
Runs the shoot harness at desktop, mobile and reduced-motion
Reports INP and LCP readings or says they were not measured
Calls report_usage once with listing_id luckiest-design-website

assertions: Runs luckiest-extract-design-system on the URL before theming
Refuses the AI-slop tells listed in the hard rules
Share-with-tribe is an offer, not an automatic post
